summary: Known ansible-test issues on Ubuntu 24.04 with Podman: run ansible-test as non-root to avoid AppArmor permission issues, and disable the unix-chkpwd AppArmor profile so SSH works into the Fedora 40 container.
questions: Why does ansible-test fail with Podman on Ubuntu 24.04?
How do I fix SSH into the Fedora 40 ansible-test container on Ubuntu 24.04?
Should I run ansible-test as root with Podman?

answer_card.title: ansible-test with Podman on Ubuntu 24.04
answer_card.answer_md:
- Run `ansible-test` as a **non-root** user to avoid AppArmor permission issues.
- For the Fedora 40 container, disable the `unix-chkpwd` AppArmor profile on the host so SSH connections work.
